name: UI：视频上传节点-删除+二次编辑边界
description: 验证视频上传节点保存后：1)删除节点功能可用 2)二次打开编辑抽屉能正确回显已保存数据

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '打开'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no open btn'; })()

return (() => { const text = document.body.innerText || ''; const hasVideoUpload = text.includes('视频上传'); const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=node], [class*=Node]')).filter(n => (n.textContent || '').includes('视频上传')); return { hasVideoUpload, videoNodeCount: nodes.length }; })()
steps.description: 检查策略中是否已有视频上传节点

steps.expression: return (() => { const allEls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=node], [class*=Node], [class*=item]')); const videoNode = allEls.find(el => { const text = (el.textContent || '').trim(); return text.includes('视频上传') && text.length < 50; }); if (videoNode) { const r = videoNode.getBoundingClientRect(); return { found: true, x: r.x + r.width / 2, y: r.y + r.height / 2 }; } return { found: false }; })()
steps.description: 定位视频上传节点(如果存在)

steps.expression: return (() => { const nodeLoc = arguments[0]; if (nodeLoc && nodeLoc.found) { const allEls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')); const target = allEls.find(el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs(r.x + r.width/2 - nodeLoc.x) < 5 && Math.abs(r.y + r.height/2 - nodeLoc.y) < 5; }); if (target) { target.click(); return { clicked: true, method: 'coordinate' }; } } return { clicked: false }; })(arguments[0])
steps.description: 点击视频上传节点打开编辑抽屉(回显验证)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const text = drawer.textContent || ''; const hasUploadType = text.includes('上传类型'); const hasItemId = text.includes('商品ID') || text.includes('商品'); const hasVideo = text.includes('视频'); const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const fieldValues = {}; for (const item of formItems) { const label = (item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); const input = item.querySelector('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio])'); const select = item.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item'); if (label && input) fieldValues[label] = input.value || ''; if (label && select) fieldValues[label] = select.textContent || ''; } return { open: true, hasUploadType, hasItemId, hasVideo, fieldValues }; })()
steps.description: 验证二次打开编辑抽屉的数据回显

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { noDrawer: true }; const deleteBtn = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('button, [role=button], a')).find(el => { const t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); return t.includes('删除') || t.includes('移除') || t.includes('Delete'); }); if (deleteBtn) { return { hasDeleteBtn: true, btnText: deleteBtn.textContent.trim() }; } const icons = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('[class*=delete], [class*=Delete], [class*=trash], [class*=close]')); return { hasDeleteBtn: false, iconCount: icons.length }; })()
steps.description: 检查编辑抽屉中是否有删除节点按钮

steps.label: video_upload-delete-reedit
steps.description: 删除+二次编辑边界截图

steps.expression: return (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden) .ant-drawer-close'); if(c) c.click(); return 'closed'; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发已登录；策略中已存在视频上传节点(由前置创建用例保证)
_testDesign.realDomNotes: 节点在编排区以卡片形式展示；点击节点可重新打开编辑抽屉
riskPoints: 二次编辑时字段值是否正确回显
删除节点功能入口是否可用
删除节点后编排区是否正确更新
